CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Judges? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Judges has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Judges.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Judges to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer.
   B. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
   B. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Writing the Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Writing the Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Writing the Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Writing the Holy Bible.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Conquest and settlement in Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conquest and settlement in Canaan.
   B. Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Conquest and settlement in Canaan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Conquest and settlement in Canaan has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem.
   B. Say Journey to Jerusalem has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Journey to Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation.
   C. Say Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Journey to Jerusalem The Way of Salvation to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Jeremiah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Prophet Jeremiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophet Jeremiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Prophet Jeremiah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophet Jeremiah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Journey to Jerusalem Fearless Confession Without Hypocrisy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

3. B — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem True Discipleship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Judges with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem Parables on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. D — Apply the teaching of Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Writing the Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Conquest and settlement in Canaan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Journey to Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
